subject: Request: Short 'Day-in-the-Life' Video Testimonial — logistics & release
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: James Park <james@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Short 'Day-in-the-Life' Video Testimonial — logistics & release

Hi James —

Thanks again for agreeing to share Solara's experience with Redwood. We want to keep this super lightweight: a 2–3 minute "day-in-the-life" clip where a clinician briefly talks through one workflow Redwood helped speed up, plus b-roll of the dashboard in use. High level plan below — want to confirm what works on your side and get the release signed.

Quick plan (proposed):
- Shoot length: 2 hours on-site (interview + 10–15 minutes of b-roll)
- Crew: 1 interviewer, 1 camera, 1 producer (studio will handle lights/audio)
- Deliverable: 2–3 minute edited testimonial + 30s cut for social
- Dates: flexible week of May 24 — tell us preferred days/times

Attached: Redwood release (redwood_release_v2.pdf), a short shoot guide (shoot_guide_v1.docx), and a draft script/talking points (script_draft.txt).

Next steps from your side:
1) Confirm preferred date range or availability windows
2) Share any location notes or security/visitor policies at the clinic
3) Sign the release (we can DocuSign if easier)

If it's helpful, Ben can join to coordinate logistics with your ops lead. Appreciate your time — this will be a quick, low-effort spotlight that we think your team will be proud to share.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0117

Attachment: redwood_release_v2.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
Attachment: shoot_guide_v1.docx (DOCX, 2 pages)
Attachment: script_draft.txt (TXT, 1 page)
From: James Park <james@solarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Kumari <asha@solarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Short 'Day-in-the-Life' Video Testimonial — logistics & release

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. This sounds doable and we appreciate the short format. Asha and I chatted and these notes:

- Best dates: May 25 or May 27 (afternoons preferred after 1pm)
- Location: Solara Main Clinic, 3rd floor training room — note: visitor badges required, camera equipment needs to be checked in at security
- People: I'll be the on-camera clinician; Asha will help coordinate and can be present for the shoot

We reviewed the release and mostly ok — two small asks:
1) Can we add a clause that limits use of patient imagery? We'll ensure no patients are filmed but want explicit language if any accidental capture occurs
2) Please confirm whether Redwood will provide a final sign-off window before publishing (we typically ask for a 48-hour approval window)

If you can send the DocuSign link for the release, we'll get it routed. Also looping in our procurement contact if there's any invoicing for studio time (we expect Redwood covers production and we reimburse travel if requested).

Thanks,
James Park
Clinical Operations Manager
Solara Health
james@solarahealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Short 'Day-in-the-Life' Video Testimonial — logistics & release

James + Marissa —

Great — glad the timing works. A few production notes from our studio partner and logistics items to confirm: 

Studio notes (Solara Video):
- We will arrive 60 minutes before shoot to set lights and test audio. Total on-site time ~3 hours.
- Equipment list: one mirrorless camera, lav mic for James, handheld for b-roll, LED panel. No heavy gear requiring dock access.
- We'll sign in at security and carry liability insurance; can share certificate if Solara requires it.

Logistics ask for Solara ops:
- Please confirm the best exterior door for load-in and whether a parking pass is needed for our van
- Visitor badge process: will a single list of names be sufficient or individual ID checks?
- Any sensitive areas to avoid filming (we will only film public/admin spaces and the clinician workspace)

On the release: we can add an explicit patient-imagery protection clause and include a 48-hour approval window before publishing. Marissa, can you update the PDF and send a DocuSign link? We can also add a short clause indicating Redwood covers base production; any travel/parking reimbursed separately per the invoice process.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate directly with the studio and loop in our producer once dates are confirmed.

Best,
Ben Carter
Customer Marketing Ops
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 628-555-0122

Subject: Re: Request: Short 'Day-in-the-Life' Video Testimonial — logistics & release

Thanks all — quick updates and next steps.

1) Release: Updated PDF attached with an explicit patient-imagery protection clause and a 48-hour approval window before any external publishing. Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rdw/solara-release-2027 (please let me know if your legal needs a copy to review).

2) Dates: James — we tentatively locked May 27 (Thursday) at 1:30pm to allow for a 1pm load-in. Please confirm final.

3) Production logistics: Studio will arrive at 12:30pm. Ben will be on-site as the Redwood point of contact. Studio asked whether a single guest-name list is enough for security; James, if you confirm, we'll provide the names.

4) Invoicing: Ben confirmed Redwood covers base production; Solara would only reimburse pre-approved travel parking if applicable. Ben, please share the insurance certificate and the small travel reimbursement SR.

If everything is ok, James/Asha can expect the DocuSign in your inbox now and a follow-up calendar invite once you confirm May 27. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

All best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
